Jules (Support): Heads-up — customer reported 401 mid-stream + duplicate completions billed after upgrading to py-sdk 1.33.0. They say it only happens on streaming calls and not on 1.32.x.
Maya (Customer): We rolled to 1.33.0 yesterday. On long streaming responses sometimes we see a 401 after a 502 and the client emits a second completion. We get two charges for the same prompt. Repro below.
Jules (Support): Repro steps from customer:
```
import os
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), timeout=30)
with c.stream_generate(model="gpt-5", prompt="long prompt ...") as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text)
```
Jules (Support): Customer log excerpt (sanitized):
```
INFO 2026-03-16 14:02:11 Sending chunk
WARN 2026-03-16 14:02:14 upstream 502, retrying
INFO 2026-03-16 14:02:14 Retry attempt 1 — re-sending stream frames
INFO 2026-03-16 14:02:14 outgoing headers: Authorization: None
ERROR 2026-03-16 14:02:14 401 Unauthorized
INFO 2026-03-16 14:02:15 emitting completion (from retry)
```
Jules (Support): Notice 'Authorization: None' on retry — looks like header got dropped during retry for streaming path.
Alex (Eng): :eyes: Can you confirm the exact python package version & install method (pip, wheel)? Also full client config and whether they use .stream_generate() context manager or manual iterator.
Maya (Customer): pip install redwood==1.33.0 from our CI wheel. Using context manager as shown. API key is standard user key (no session tokens).
Priya (Escalations): This smells like our retry transport not preserving per-request auth for chunked/streamed uploads. Assigning to eng-runtime. Please collect request/response IDs and full request headers if possible.
Jules (Support): Workaround suggested to customer: pin to 1.32.4 and increase timeout until we ship fix. They asked for a hotfix estimate.
Alex (Eng): I can reproduce locally. Root cause: when the streaming socket re-opens we rebuild the request without copying auth header from the original request object. I'll open a tiny patch to carry headers through retries.
Alex (Eng): Temporary client-side workaround for customer if they can't pin (inject header at application layer):
```
# workaround: force Authorization header on every request
import os
from redwood.transport import HTTPTransport
orig = client._transport
class HeaderInject(HTTPTransport):
    def request(self, method, path, headers=None, **kw):
        headers = headers or {}
        headers['Authorization'] = f"Bearer {os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}"
        return orig.request(method, path, headers=headers, **kw)
client._transport = HeaderInject()
```
Priya (Escalations): Triage ticket created: ENG-1234. Hotfix target: 1.33.1 with header preservation on retry. ETA ~4 hours if no regressions. If customer needs faster, advise pin to 1.32.4.
Maya (Customer): thanks — pinning now and will report back. Appreciate the quick help :pray:

Alex (Eng): Will follow up in thread with PR link and release notes. :thumbsup:
